question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The teacher asked us to _______ our essays for spelling and grammar errors.
solution:
The correct answer is '**revise**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "revise" means to review or make changes to something, especially written content. In this case, it refers to checking and correcting essays for spelling and grammar errors.
 
• "Advise" means to give recommendations or guidance, which is not the correct action in this context.
 
• "Recognise" means to identify something or someone, which is not appropriate for reviewing essays for errors.
 
• "Revolve" means to move around something in a circular motion, which does not fit the context of editing essays.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The teacher asked us to revise__ our essays for spelling and grammar errors.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Advise (सलाह देना)**: means to give guidance or recommendations, not applicable in the context of reviewing an essay.
 
• **Recognise (पहचानना)**: means to identify something or someone, but it is not used in the context of reviewing or editing written work.
 
• **Revolve (घूमना)**: refers to movement in a circular path, which is irrelevant to the task of editing essays.
